question: I need you to look into the actor collaborations and tell me how many actors have made more films with Yash Chopra than with any other director. This will help us understand his influence on the industry better.
sql:
WITH yc_actors AS (
    SELECT TRIM(mc.PID) as actor_pid, COUNT(DISTINCT mc.MID) as films_with_yc
    FROM M_Cast mc
    JOIN M_Director md ON mc.MID = md.MID
    WHERE TRIM(md.PID) = 'nm0007181'
    GROUP BY TRIM(mc.PID)
),
actor_director_films AS (
    SELECT a.actor_pid, TRIM(md.PID) as director_pid, COUNT(DISTINCT mc.MID) as film_count
    FROM yc_actors a
    JOIN M_Cast mc ON a.actor_pid = TRIM(mc.PID)
    JOIN M_Director md ON mc.MID = md.MID
    WHERE TRIM(md.PID) != 'nm0007181'
    GROUP BY a.actor_pid, TRIM(md.PID)
),
max_other_director AS (
    SELECT actor_pid, MAX(film_count) as max_films_with_other
    FROM actor_director_films
    GROUP BY actor_pid
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as actor_count
FROM yc_actors yc
LEFT JOIN max_other_director mo ON yc.actor_pid = mo.actor_pid
WHERE yc.films_with_yc > COALESCE(mo.max_films_with_other, 0)
